author: SickProdigy
description: Connect Navidrome, manage linked users and announcements, and optionally submit confirmed artist or album requests through Lidarr.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild connection selections, announcement settings, account mappings, Lidarr request policy, and a bounded request audit. Owner and guild Navidrome/Lidarr credentials are stored separately in isolated Red shared API token namespaces. User-data deletion removes account mappings and anonymizes matching audit attribution.
install_msg: Run `[p]navidromeset setup` to select an owner-approved connection. Bot owners may enable isolated guild-managed public-HTTPS connections with `[p]navidromeowner guildconnections true`. Album notifications are optional.
name: Navidrome
short: Per-server Navidrome management with optional Lidarr requests
